findings.summary: Default _default_has_harvest_receipt matches only note_type=evidence + card_entity_id and cannot enforce the evidence- idempotency_key prefix, because the agent-bus messages read surface does not expose idempotency_key; the exact evidence- predicate is correctly delegated to the injectable has_harvest_receipt, which the TestHarvestableView cases exercise. Production default therefore over-matches evidence notes (conservative: never re-lists an already-harvested card), consistent with spec item 2's injectable seam.
